tool: axe-core 4.10 (WCAG 2.0 A/AA, WCAG 2.1 AA, best practice), run in headless Chromium against the live site
keyboard: console: Tab reaches each work package (a button with an accessible name: priority, road, state); Enter opens it and moves focus to the detail; decision messages are announced (role=status)
other: colour is never the only signal (severity and priority are also written as text); priority badges meet WCAG AA contrast with white text; layout stacks on phones (390 px tested)
